'''Port Jerrell''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Port Jerrell was known to be a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] haven.
